primitives.note: Once the recalled Spirit Blade reaches Shen, his next 3 basic attacks within 8s deal bonus magic on-hit damage.

The empowered-attack bonus scales off the target's maximum health, and jumps to a higher (enhanced) tier if the Spirit Blade hit an enemy champion during its travel; against structures only the flat portion applies.

Whether the Spirit Blade's recall path actually overlaps the single target (needed to decide base vs. enhanced empowered-attack tier and the AS buff) depends on Shen's position relative to the target, which a stationary 1v1 dummy fight must assume one way or the other.
50% bonus attack speed for 8s (AttackBuffDuration) if the Spirit Blade hit an enemy champion en route, granted alongside the enhanced empowered attacks.
Shadow Dash deals a flat+bonus-HP-scaled physical damage instance to enemies it passes through, once per cast, on a fixed post-dash cooldown.
Energy costs (Q 140-100, W 40, E 150) constrain how often abilities can be recast in a 15s fight; Q and E hits also refund energy (E's refund fires at most once per cast).
Shadow Dash's cooldown starts only after the dash ends (post-effect), not on cast, effectively lengthening its real cooldown relative to a naive on-cast timer.
Ki Barrier's self-shield (after any ability completes), Spirit's Refuge's attack-block zone, and Stand United's ally shield are all read only by the survival fight, never by the damage fight.

needsBespoke.why: Shen's damage-relevant kit is a resource-gated empowered-attack ability (Q) whose tier depends on a geometric hit-check during a projectile recall, plus a plain-cast dash nuke (E) with a post-effect cooldown and shared energy refunds, and purely defensive shields/blocks (P, W, R) that only matter for the survival fight. All of this is expressible with existing primitives once the Q hit-check assumption is settled; no unique stacking/resource/transform system requires bespoke logic.

unsettled.question: In the 1v1 damage fight, does the recalled Spirit Blade actually pass through/overlap the single target on each Q cast, thereby granting the enhanced (higher, description3) empowered-attack damage tier and the 50% bonus attack speed buff, or does it return to Shen without hitting anything (giving only the base description2 tier and no AS buff)?
options: Assume the blade always overlaps the target (best case: enhanced tier + AS buff every Q cast)
Assume the blade never overlaps the target because it starts adjacent to Shen with no travel distance to intercept anything (worst case: base tier only, no AS buff)
Model it as a positioning choice the simulator must fix once per fight rather than per-cast

unsettled.question: If Twilight Assault (Q) is recast while the previous cast's 3 empowered attacks have not all been consumed, does the new cast reset the counter to 3 (and overwrite the tier/AS buff), stack additively, or is the recast simply wasted until the charges are used up?
options: New cast resets/overwrites to a fresh 3-attack window at the new tier
Charges add on top of remaining ones, up to some cap
Not addressed by either source; treat as reset since only one buff instance is described
quotes: Once it arrives, '''Shen''' empowers his next 3 {{tip|basic attacks}} within 8 seconds to gain {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}.

proposal: Auto-attack the target continuously throughout the 15s window; basic attacks (especially empowered ones) are Shen's primary damage source.
Cast Twilight Assault (Q) as the opener to arm the next 3 basic attacks with bonus magic on-hit damage.
Cast Shadow Dash (E) through the target as soon as available for its flat+bonus-HP physical damage hit and its energy refund; recast on cooldown thereafter (cooldown starts only once the dash ends).
Recast Twilight Assault every time it comes off cooldown, prioritizing keeping empowered charges up so as many basic attacks as possible land while armed.
If the enhanced (champion-hit) tier and its 50% attack speed buff are available, weight Q recasts to maximize uptime of that buff since it also increases the auto-attack rate.
Never cast Spirit's Refuge (W) or Stand United (R) in the damage fight: they deal no damage and only matter for survival.
Manage energy spending between Q (100-140) and E (150) so that neither ability is ever starved of energy for a full cast cycle across the 15s.
